ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) pigmentation across approximately 90% of surface; high-intensity white punctate spots scattered primarily in the lower-central region near the peduncle attachment; low-contrast greyish mottling at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch; calculated interior angle at the vertex is approximately 95 degrees; significant depth relative to total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with variable amplitude and high frequency across the entire posterior boundary; more pronounced jagged edges at the terminal lateral points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast textured clusters at the distal tips; widespread distribution of small, circular white high-intensity clusters across the lower half of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent dark, parallel linear rake marks extending vertically and diagonally on the upper lateral portions of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct vertical rake marks on both lobes; significant barnacle colonization and associated scarring at the terminal fluke tips.
